The focus of the Healthcare System has been traditionally to respond when people are already sick. Ontarian's are aging and chronic diseases such as arthritis are on the rise. Our hope is that we can teach people and give them the right tools to avoid these chronic diseases by becoming more proactive and more educated about how to take care of themselves and their bodies. For several years we have been working with people and have specialized in the areas of chronic pain, sports injury, pregnancy care, pediatrics, women's health, motor vehicle accident and work injury rehabilitation. 

By bringing together our past clinical experience and knowledge to Edgar Family Chiropractic, we are hoping to create a warm and healing family environment where we can nurture our patients and their families with a natural and gentle approach to optimal health.
